Game Overview

Jumping Planets is a hyper-casual title where quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Jumping Planets doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Jumping Planets?

Jumping Planets is a free hyper-casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Jumping Planets free to play?

Yes, Jumping Planets is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
